findings.title: What it is
findings.said: A plain wallet: someone's private key, no code.

findings.title: How long the wallet has existed
findings.said: It has no history at all: the explorer has never seen a transaction to or from it.
findings.why: An address nobody has used gives you nothing to go on. If someone asked you to pay it, check it really is theirs.

findings.title: Who paid for its first gas
findings.said: The explorer doesn't show who first funded this wallet.

findings.title: Approvals it left open
findings.said: It has never sent an approve transaction that the explorer lists.

findings.title: Who lets it move their tokens
findings.said: 1 other wallet gave this plain wallet the right to move their tokens, and it is still open: 0xa95f…d91b on token 0xc879…1815. Seen in the last 100000 blocks (about 26 hours).
findings.why: Apps take approvals through contracts. A bare wallet collecting other people's approvals can pull their tokens whenever it likes: that's how approval drainers get paid.
